answer_1.quote: Automated program repair (APR)... can mitigate the costs associated with bug fixing ... by automatically generating fixing patches.

answer_2.quote: We selected the hyperparameters with F1 score... patches considered successful if any patch within the top‑k was correct. An exact match with the developer's patch was considered as a correct patch.

answer_4.quote: The generated patches are verified through manual or test case evaluations to filter out incorrect patches.
answer_4.guideline: Developers manually verify the generated patches.
